comment: Which ServerPackCreator versions this site serves documentation for, BESIDES the one being
released -- assemble-docs.sh folds that in from SPC_RELEASE_VERSION, so it is never listed here.
`latest` is what /help/latest and /api/latest point at on a build that is not a release.
A VERSION LISTED HERE NEEDS A PUBLISHED RELEASE, NOT MERELY A TAG. Its API reference is fetched
from the release's `serverpackcreator-api-<version>-dokka-html.zip` asset, and a tag carries no
assets. 9.2.0 was listed here and removed on 2026-10-12: the tag 0f5ef5a8c exists on Forgejo and
the release object does not, so both forges answer 404 for that asset and the build fails hard.
MEASURED COST PER VERSION, 2026-10-12: the Dokka tree is 20 MB over 1,411 files and the webhelp
is 4.2 MB over 62, so ~24 MB on disk -- but ~3 MB of what anyone actually pulls, because both
are HTML and compress about 15:1 in a layer (the Dokka tree is 1.3 MB as a tar.gz, the webhelp
1.83 MB as its own zip). Prune this list for disk, not for download size.
